agenda_text:
PEDESTRIAN SAFETY ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 11, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  2ND FL CONFERENCE RM – THE BEACH, 4:00 PM

Wendy Ili, Vice Chair  Kaferman Guan, Member
Jill Birdwell, Member  Rhea Lewitzki, Member
Brandi Brown-Shock, Member  Michelle Mowery, Member
Roberto Castillo, Member  Danielle Potter, Member

Paul Van Dyk, City Traffic Engineer, Chair  Vacant, PTA Representative
Vacant, Nonpublic Schools Representative  Kezia Bailey, LBUSD Representative

  REVISED

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55648  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Pedestrian Safety Advisory
  Committee meeting of Thursday, May 16, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55649  Recommendation to receive and file a summary of Adult Crossing Guard Location
  Analysis.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55650  Recommendation to conduct a study session on the criteria for school guard
  locations based on the City municipal code and the prioritization of factors for
  placing adult crossing guards at school crossings that meet the specific criteria of
  Long Beach Municipal Code (LBMC) Section 10.68.010 and school crossings that
  do not meet the specific criteria outlined in LBMC 10.68.010.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Pedestrian Safety Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
